result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The two answers are nearly identical: both have side-by-side panels, a warm near-black dark background with off-white text, dark cards with a slightly lighter surface and a subtle border, and readable muted text. B's dark-mode accent is a softer, less saturated coral, so its play buttons stand out without glowing. A's dark accent is brighter and more saturated and looks a little harsh. Both use the accent only on the play buttons and the 'cast' part of the logo. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): The two answers are almost identical: both show matching light and dark panels with warm near-black backgrounds, slightly lighter cards with subtle borders, and readable muted text. A softens its dark-mode accent to a calmer coral. B's dark accent stays brighter and more saturated, so its play buttons glow a bit more against the dark background. That gives A a small edge on rubric item 4.
